text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin has managed to leave quite a mark on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Together, we've successfully navigated the crucial first three years of her career.

text_block_list.name: Footage
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin crosses the finish line! She's claimed first place!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: This takes me back…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: We competed in all sorts of races together, didn't we, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Looking back over all those races like this, I realized something—there's a point when I stopped collapsing as much after I finished.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: At first, I figured my body had gotten used to holding back a little, but… honestly, I still don't think I ever had much stamina left at the end.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So I dunno… it's weird, right?
choice_data_list: What could be the reason behind it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Maybe everyone's cheers gave me strength.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It was the same during the Derby. The moment I heard those voices, it felt like my legs regained a little strength.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I want to keep earning that same kind of support from here on out, so—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt… Bzzzt…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah, sorry. It's my manager calling.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hello? Yes, I checked next week's shift! Okay, see you then!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Say, Trainer. Is it okay if we go over next week's schedule?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm more than used to having these discussions by now. I open the schedule planner and get my notebook ready.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You're a lifesaver! Thank you, oh benevolent Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! Let's find the days I'm not working and pack them out with training sessions!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna keep giving it my very best!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That way, everyone else can keep cheering me on!
